text: Show that the sum of two even integers is even.
lean: (a b : ℤ) (ha : Even a) (hb : Even b) : Even (a + b)

text: Show that the square of an odd integer is odd.
lean: (n : ℤ) (h : Odd n) : Odd (n ^ 2)

text: Show that n^2 + n is even for every integer n.
lean: (n : ℤ) : Even (n ^ 2 + n)

text: Show that if a divides b and b divides c, then a divides c (integers).
lean: (a b c : ℤ) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : b ∣ c) : a ∣ c

text: Show that 3 divides n^3 - n for every integer n.
Let a and b be coprime integers that both divide c. Show that ab divides c.
lean: (a b c : ℤ) (h : IsCoprime a b) (ha : a ∣ c) (hb : b ∣ c) : a * b ∣ c

text: Show that the sum of the first n odd numbers, 1 + 3 + ... + (2n - 1), equals n^2.
lean: (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2

text: Show that 2(1 + 2 + ... + n) = n(n + 1) for every natural number n.
lean: (n : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i = n * (n + 1)

text: Show that 1 + 2 + 4 + ... + 2^(n-1) = 2^n - 1 for every natural number n.
lean: (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 : ℕ) ^ i = 2 ^ n - 1

text: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational.
lean: : Irrational (Real.sqrt 2)

text: Prove that there are infinitely many primes: for every natural number n there is a prime p with p ≥ n.
lean: (n : ℕ) : ∃ p, n ≤ p ∧ Nat.Prime p

text: Show that the composition of two injective functions is injective.
lean: {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) : Function.Injective (g ∘ f)

text: Show that the composition of two surjective functions is surjective.
lean: {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) : Function.Surjective (g ∘ f)

text: Let f : A → B and g : B → C. Show that if g ∘ f is injective, then f is injective.
lean: {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (h : Function.Injective (g ∘ f)) : Function.Injective f

text: Show that a strictly increasing function from the reals to the reals is injective.
lean: (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : StrictMono f) : Function.Injective f

text: Show that A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) for any sets A, B, C.
lean: {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C)

text: Show that the complement of A ∪ B is the intersection of the complements of A and B.
lean: {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : (A ∪ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ

text: Let f : X → Y and A, B ⊆ Y. Show that the preimage of A ∩ B is the intersection of the preimages of A and B.
lean: {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (A B : Set β) : f ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) = f ⁻¹' A ∩ f ⁻¹' B

text: Show that 2xy ≤ x^2 + y^2 for all real numbers x and y.
Show that sqrt(ab) ≤ (a + b)/2 for all real a, b ≥ 0.
lean: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a + b) / 2

text: Show that |x + y| ≤ |x| + |y| for all real numbers x and y.
Show that 1/(n+1) tends to 0: for every ε > 0 there is N such that |1/(n+1)| < ε for all n ≥ N.
Show that if a_n → A and b_n → B, then a_n + b_n → A + B.
lean: (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ) (ha : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds A)) (hb : Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds B)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n + b n) Filter.atTop (nhds (A + B))

text: Show from the ε-δ definition that x^2 is continuous at 1: for every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that |x - 1| < δ implies |x^2 - 1| < ε.
Let f : [0,1] → [0,1] be continuous. Show that there is c in [0,1] with f(c) = c.
lean: (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 1)) (hmap : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f c = c
